menu_items.name: Butter Croissant
menu_items.description:
Butter croissant is a classic french pastry shaped like a crescent, known for its delicate, flaky layers created by folding dough with generous amounts of butter.
With each bite, you get a crispy golden exterior and a soft, melt-in-your-mouth interior, all infused with the rich aroma of fresh butter.
Its golden sheen comes from an egg wash before baking, while the repeated rolling and folding give it its signature layered look.

menu_items.name: Brown Sourdough Loof 2 Slices
menu_items.description:
A slice of brown sourdough bread has a darker, crunchier crust and a soft yet denser interior compared to white sourdough.
Its flavor is deeper and richer, with a pronounced tang and a subtle nutty note from the use of whole wheat flour or a blend of grains.
The crumb is less airy but full of texture, making it perfect with strong cheeses or as a base for hearty sandwiches with vegetables and roasted meats.

menu_items.name: Sunny Miette
menu_items.description:
Sunny-side-up eggs with sourdough toast, fresh vegetables, and oven-roasted potatoes
Fresh eggs are served with a slice of sourdough toast, alongside a selection of fresh vegetables and oven-roasted potatoes. This meal makes a quick and delicious breakfast, and salt, pepper, or other seasonings can be added to taste.

menu_items.name: Scrambled Eggs
menu_items.description:
Scrambled eggs with sourdough toast, fresh vegetables, and oven-roasted potatoes
Fresh scrambled eggs are served with a slice of sourdough toast, alongside a selection of fresh vegetables and oven-roasted potatoes. This meal makes a quick and delicious breakfast, and salt, pepper, or other seasonings can be added to taste.

menu_items.name: Plain Omelette
menu_items.description:
Delicious plain omelette with sourdough toast, fresh vegetables, and oven-roasted potatoes
This simple and classic meal consists of a plain omelette made by whisking fresh eggs until set, without adding any fillings. The omelette is usually folded and served hot, with a pinch of salt and pepper. It is accompanied by a slice of sourdough toast, a selection of fresh vegetables, and oven-roasted potatoes, making it a quick and delicious breakfast.

menu_items.name: Omelette Veggie
menu_items.description:
Veggie Omelette with Sourdough Toast, Fresh Vegetables, and Oven-Roasted Potatoes
This delicious and nutritious meal consists of a veggie omelette made by whisking fresh eggs and cooking them, with the addition of a variety of vegetables such as bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes. The omelette is usually folded and served hot, seasoned with a pinch of salt, pepper, and herbs to taste. It is accompanied by a slice of sourdough toast, a selection of fresh vegetables, and oven-roasted potatoes, making it a complete, quick, and tasty breakfast meal.

menu_items.name: Omelette Cheese
menu_items.description:
Cheese Omelette with Sourdough Toast, Fresh Vegetables, and Oven-Roasted Potatoes
This delicious and nutritious meal consists of an omelette made by whisking fresh eggs and cooking them, with the addition of flavorful Emmental cheese and tasty Cheddar cheese that melt to give the omelette a creamy and delicious texture. The omelette is usually folded and served hot, seasoned with a pinch of salt, pepper, and herbs to taste. It is accompanied by a slice of sourdough toast, a selection of fresh vegetables, and oven-roasted potatoes, making it a complete, quick, and tasty breakfast.

Brookies are a dessert that combines rich chocolate brownies with soft cookies in a single treat.
They typically have a dense, fudgy brownie layer on the bottom, topped with a golden cookie layer studded with chocolate chips.
